async(req,res)=>{try{if(req.body?.confirmed!==true)throw Error('请先人工核对平台提示');const a=(await store.listAccounts()).find(a=>a.id===req.params.id);if(!a)return res.sendStatus(404);const device=await connectorChannel?.binding(scope.current(),a.profile);if(!device||!connectorChannel)throw Error('请连接账号原执行电脑');const lock=browserRuns?.active(a.handle);if(lock){if(lock.profile!==a.profile)throw Error('请先核对原执行电脑，不能在新电脑解除旧任务');let path:string;const task=(await studioApi?.list())?.find(t=>t.id===lock.id&&t.accountId===a.id);if(task?.executionRunId)path='/studio/'+task.executionRunId+'/cancel';else{const job=await xhsSync?.status(lock.id);if(!job||job.accountId!==a.id)throw Error('旧任务尚未核对，请联系管理员');path='/sync/'+lock.id+'/cancel';}const stopped=await connectorChannel.json(scope.current(),device,'POST',path,{});if(stopped.stopConfirmed!==true)throw Error('停止尚未确认，请稍后再次核对');browserRuns?.release(lock.id);}res.json(await connectorChannel.json(scope.current(),device,'POST','/accounts/'+a.profile.slice(6)+'/resume',{confirmed:true}));}catch(e){res.status(409).json({message:e instanceof Error?e.message:'恢复失败'});}}
